title: State
description: Full pipeline state after each pair. Architecture §3 row 2: actions, outcomes tree, intentions, requirements, slots, operations_log.

actions.description: All actions extracted by Step 1a across all pairs so far.

id.description: Action identifier: U(pair, seq) for user, A(pair, seq) for AI.

type.description: Open-vocabulary action type from Step 1a, e.g. 'specifying requirement'.

role.description: Most load-bearing field: determines influence math.

evidence_quote.description: Verbatim quote from the dialogue that grounds this action.

outcomes.description: Goal/outcome tree from Step 1b. Parent/child links form the tree.

text.description: The outcome's deliverable description (displayed in Goal section).

turn_id.description: Action id of the introducing action, anchoring the outcome in time.

parent.description: Parent outcome_id, or null for root.

children.description: Child outcome_ids. Must agree bidirectionally with parent.

intention.description: Short human-readable label for the intention.

outcome_ids.description: Outcome ids grouped under this intention.

requirements.description: All requirements extracted by Step 2 across all outcomes.

outcome_id.description: The outcome this requirement belongs to.

req_id.description: Requirement id unique within its outcome, e.g. 'req 1'. Always read as (outcome_id, req_id).

creation_action_ids.description: Action ids that introduced this requirement (direct influence trace).

contributing_action_ids.description: Action ids that supported without introducing (indirect influence trace).

implementation_action_ids.description: Action ids that implemented this requirement.

revise_action_ids.description: Action ids from Step 3 REVISES labels, distinguishing revision from implementation.

related_to.description: Other req_ids within the same outcome (version-history chain).

explicit_or_implicit.description: Whether the requirement was directly stated or inferred.

rationale.description: Free-text audit trail for the extraction.

created_at_pair.description: The pair in which this requirement was first created.

slots.description: Open slots (hedged/deferred decisions) from Step 2's open_slot ops.

slot_id.description: Slot identifier unique within its outcome, e.g. 'slot 1'.

outcome_id.description: The outcome this slot belongs to.

origin.description: user = ceded decision, AI = hedged proposal.

creation_action_ids.description: Action ids that raised the hedge.

contributing_action_ids.description: Action ids adding context without raising the slot.

resolved_into.description: If resolved, the req_id it became. Null if still open or abandoned.

operations_log.description: Chronological log of all requirement and slot operations across all pairs.

pair.description: The pair in which this operation occurred.

op.description: The operation type (requirement ops + slot ops).

target_id.description: The req_id or slot_id this operation targets.

target_type.description: Whether the target is a requirement or a slot.
